text: CLI program in Python that validates a JSON config file against a JSON schema file
Supports type checks: string, integer, number, boolean, array, object (bool not integer/number)
Error messages address nested fields using dot notation
Reports all errors at once, not only the first
Implied: valid config reports success (exit 0); invalid config exits non-zero
Implied: missing/malformed input files produce a clear error, not a traceback
